stack: Lottie JSON players mounted into empty containers

notes: The captured stylesheet is Emotion's computed output: zero CSS custom properties exist on the page (`architecture.tokens.count: 0`), so every value above is an inferred token — the exact literal that recurs across hashed classes, not a name the site uses. Ink is warm and tiered; #4b4c4d is the true body color (2,003 nodes) while #2d2c2b is heading ink — `fg` names the heading tier, `fg-body` the paragraph tier, since a single `fg` would misrepresent the ramp. `border-strong` (#c6c1b9) and `band-navy` (#27455c) appear only a handful of times and are close to sampled. Type scale is the union of the three-breakpoint ramps (display steps 2.25→2.5→3.25→4rem; 4.5rem occurs once, in the promo banner); browser-computed fallbacks (16.5186px, 13.008px, 14.4px) and their matching line-heights are dropped as em-inheritance noise. Tracking is stated as a ratio, not px: every heading measured at exactly -0.03em (64px/-1.92, 52px/-1.56, 32px/-0.96, 24px/-0.72), body at -0.12px/16px. Radius normalized: raw 32px/800px/112px/7rem pills all collapse to the capsule tier (9999px); 1px/2px/2.5px/3px values are icon and outline artifacts, dropped. Weights 200/600 are loaded and declared but effectively unused on this page — 500 is the body weight, 700 the heading weight. `craft.theme.supportsDark` reports true but its payload is degenerate (bg rgba(0,0,0,0), accent rgba(0,0,0,0), surfaces identical to the light theme), so `color.dark` is omitted rather than invented — the site does not re-theme. Durations/easings come from the stylesheet, not the profile's rounded values; the single 150ms + cubic-bezier(0.32,0.94,0.6,1) pair covers essentially all interactive state.
